description.sl: Babica Resi vas povabi v svojo kuhinjo: lupiti, rezati, pražiti, začiniti in mešati, ponev in pečica, testo in sestavine, kvas za reindling, sladkor v prahu za krofe. Avstrijsko: das Backrohr, die Germ, das Schlagobers, der Karfiol, die Fisolen.
description.en: Oma Resi asks you into her kitchen: peeling, cutting, frying, seasoning and stirring, the pan and the oven, the dough and its ingredients, yeast for the Reindling, icing sugar for the doughnuts. Austrian: das Backrohr, die Germ, das Schlagobers, der Karfiol, die Fisolen.
description.it: Nonna Resi vi invita nella sua cucina: sbucciare, tagliare, friggere, condire e mescolare, la padella e il forno, l'impasto e gli ingredienti, il lievito per il Reindling, lo zucchero a velo per i krapfen. In austriaco: das Backrohr, die Germ, das Schlagobers, der Karfiol, die Fisolen.

review: de, sl, en, it: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker
